bank.name: Surahs & Key Verses
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: Facts about the Surahs of the Quran and their famous verses.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is also called the 'Umm-ul-Quran' (Mother of the Quran)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fatiha is known as Umm-ul-Quran (Mother of the Quran) and Umm-ul-Kitab.

questions.prompt: Which Surah protects against punishment of the grave according to hadith?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Mulk (Tabarak) is reported to intercede for its reciter and protect against the punishment of the grave.

questions.prompt: Which two Surahs are recited for protection and are called 'Al-Mu'awwidhatayn'?
questions.explanation: Al-Falaq and An-Nas are the Mu'awwidhatayn, the two Surahs of seeking refuge.

questions.prompt: In which Surah is the 'Nur' (Light) verse, the most famous verse on veiling, found?
questions.explanation: The Verse of Light (Ayat an-Nur) is in Surah An-Nur (24:35).

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed completely at once, causing the narrator to faint at its magnificence?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-An'am is said to have been revealed all at once, accompanied by angels.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Fil (The Elephant) refers to the attack on the Kaaba by which army?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fil narrates the destruction of Abraha's elephant army, which attacked the Kaaba in the Year of the Elephant.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called the 'Surah of Unity' (Tawheed)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas is the Surah of pure Tawheed; it equals a third of the Quran in reward.

questions.prompt: Which verse commands Muslims to fast during the month of Ramadan?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:183 prescribes fasting in Ramadan: 'O you who believe! Fasting is prescribed for you...'

questions.prompt: Which Surah begins without 'Bismillah'?
questions.explanation: Surah At-Tawbah is the only Surah that does not begin with Bismillah.

questions.prompt: Bismillah appears twice in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Bismillah appears at the start of Surah An-Naml and again inside it (27:30).

questions.prompt: Which Surah's theme is the victory of Makkah and is one of the shortest Surahs?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nasr (3 verses) announces the victory of Makkah and the people entering Islam in crowds.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is known for its mention of the Prophet's (PBUH) character as 'a great moral character'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Qalam (68:4) says: 'And indeed, you are of a great moral character.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah addresses the wives of the Prophet (PBUH) regarding purdah and family life?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ahzab contains the rules of purdah and addresses the Prophet's wives.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called the 'Surah of Manners' (Akhlaq), covering respect and etiquette?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Hujurat covers social ethics — verifying news, avoiding mockery, and good manners.

questions.prompt: In which Surah is the story of Prophet Yusuf (AS), called 'Ahsan-ul-Qasas' (the best of stories), narrated?
questions.explanation: Surah Yusuf narrates the complete story of Prophet Yusuf (AS), described as the best of stories.

questions.prompt: Which Surah contains the story of the 'People of the Cave' (Ashab-e-Kahf)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf narrates the story of the People of the Cave and is recommended for recitation on Fridays.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is a conversation between Allah and the angels about the creation of Adam (AS)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah (2:30-38) opens with Allah's dialogue with the angels about creating Adam (AS).

questions.prompt: How many verses are there in the Holy Quran in total?
questions.explanation: The Quran has 6,236 verses (by the Kufan count), though counts vary slightly by school.

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the 'Zul-Qarnain' and Gog and Magog (Yajuj and Majuj)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf (18) tells of Zul-Qarnain building a barrier against Yajuj and Majuj.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'the Surah of the ants' for mentioning Prophet Sulaiman (AS)?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Naml (The Ant) includes Sulaiman's (AS) story with the ant and the hoopoe.

questions.prompt: The 'Ayat-ul-Mubahila' (verse of mutual cursing) is in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ul-Mubahila (3:61) in Surah Al-Imran concerns the delegation of Najran.

questions.prompt: Which Surah opens with 'Alif Lam Meem, Zalikal Kitabu la rayba fih'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:1-2 begins with Alif Lam Meem and 'This is the Book about which there is no doubt.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed at Mina and is the shortest Madani Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kawthar, revealed in Makkah or Madinah (scholars differ), is the shortest Surah with 3 verses.

questions.prompt: Which Surah begins with 'Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Falaq (113) begins 'Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the 'Cave' and 'The Owner of the Two Gardens' as parables?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf contains four stories including the man with two gardens.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is referred to as 'Al-Bara'at' (repudiation) and was revealed regarding treaties?
questions.explanation: Surah At-Tawbah is also called Al-Bara'at, dealing with the annulment of treaties with the polytheists.

questions.prompt: Which Surah's verse 9 is called 'Ayat-ul-Kursi'?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ul-Kursi is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah, the verse of the Throne.

questions.prompt: In which Surah is the story of the 'people of the city' (Ashab-ul-Qaryah) mentioned?
questions.explanation: Surah Yaseen (36) tells of the messengers sent to a city and the man who rushed from its outskirts.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Surah al-Hamd' (praise) for beginning with praise of Allah?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatiha begins 'Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin' — all praise is for Allah.

questions.prompt: Which Surah describes the 'Battle of Badr' in detail?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Anfal (Spoils of War) was revealed after Badr and details its lessons.

questions.prompt: Which Surah was revealed regarding the 'Battle of the Trench' and the Banu Qurayzah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ahzab (The Confederates) narrates the siege of Madinah in 5 AH.

questions.prompt: Which Surah ends with the two 'Qul a'udhu' verses?
options: Al-Falaq and An-Nas are separate Surahs (113-114)
questions.explanation: The last two Surahs, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, are the Mu'awwidhatayn seeking refuge.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Al-Mu'mina' or 'Surah of Faith' for its repeated call 'O you who believe'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ma'idah (The Table) frequently addresses 'O you who believe' and completes the religion.

questions.prompt: Which Surah contains the longest verse (Ayat-ud-Dain) about debt?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ud-Dain (2:282) on written contracts of debt is the Quran's longest verse.

questions.prompt: In which Surah does Allah command the Prophet (PBUH) to declare 'Qul huwa Allahu ahad'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas (112) commands: 'Say: He is Allah, the One.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah is known for the verse of 'sabr and salat' (seek help through patience and prayer)?
questions.explanation: 2:153 tells believers to seek help through patience (sabr) and prayer (salat).

questions.prompt: Which Surah's theme is the Oneness of Allah against polytheism, addressed to the disbelievers?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kafirun (109) declares disavowal of disbelief: 'For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the 'people of the elephant' (Ashab-ul-Fil)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fil (105) recounts how Allah destroyed Abraha's elephant army.

questions.prompt: Which Surah commands the unity and cooperation of the Quraysh in trade journeys?
questions.explanation: Surah Quraysh (106) reminds the Quraysh of Allah's favours in their winter and summer journeys.

questions.prompt: In which Surah is the story of the Prophet Musa (AS) meeting Khidr (AS)?
questions.explanation: The journey of Musa (AS) with Khidr (AS) is narrated in Surah Al-Kahf (18:60-82).

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'Al-Mulk' for its opening 'Tabarakallazi biyadihil-mulk'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Mulk (67) begins 'Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah describes the events of the 'Day of Judgment' in detail and is called 'Al-Qari'ah'?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Qari'ah (101) depicts the Striking Calamity — the Day of Judgment.

questions.prompt: Which Surah ends with 'Surah An-Nas' as the final revelation chapter?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nas (Mankind) is the 114th and final Surah of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is known as 'Al-Saif' (the Sword) for its command regarding the polytheists?
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah 9:5 (Ayat as-Saif) concerns the treatment of treaty-breaking polytheists.

questions.prompt: Which Surah contains the 'Verse of Purification' (Ayat-ul-Tathir)?
questions.explanation: Ayat-ul-Tathir (33:33) addresses the Ahl al-Bayt: 'Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity.'

questions.prompt: Which Surah begins with 'Alam nashrah laka sadrak' (Did We not expand for you your breast)?
questions.explanation: Surah Ash-Sharh (94), also called Al-Inshirah, comforts the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Baqarah contains the longest verse, Ayat-ul-Dayn, at:
questions.explanation: Verse 2:282 deals with debt contracts.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas are together called:
questions.explanation: They are the two protective surahs.

questions.prompt: Surah An-Nasr mentions which event?
questions.explanation: An-Nasr celebrates the victory of Makkah.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Kawthar means:
questions.explanation: Al-Kawthar means abundance.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Asr emphasises:
questions.explanation: Al-Asr warns about the loss of time.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Humazah condemns:
questions.explanation: It criticises backbiters and wealth hoarders.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Ma'un deals with:
questions.explanation: Al-Ma'un condemns neglecting charity.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Fil narrates the story of:
questions.explanation: Al-Fil recalls Abraha's elephant army.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Quraish is addressed to:
questions.explanation: It reminds Quraysh of Allah's favours.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Balad takes its name from:
questions.explanation: Al-Balad refers to the city of Makkah.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Fajr takes its name from:
questions.explanation: Al-Fajr means the dawn.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Ghashiyah describes:
questions.explanation: Al-Ghashiyah depicts the Hour.

questions.prompt: Surah At-Tin swears by:
questions.explanation: At-Tin opens with the fig and olive.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Alaq's first word is:
questions.explanation: Al-Alaq begins with 'Read!'.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Qadr declares Lailat-ul-Qadr better than:
questions.explanation: Verse 3 states it is better than a thousand months.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Bayyinah refers to:
questions.explanation: Al-Bayyinah means the clear evidence.

questions.prompt: Surah Az-Zalzalah describes:
questions.explanation: Az-Zalzalah portrays the great quake.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Adiyat swears by:
questions.explanation: Al-Adiyat opens with the war horses.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Kafirun commands:
questions.explanation: Al-Kafirun declares separation from false worship.

questions.prompt: Surah An-Nasr mentions:
options: The help of Allah and victory
questions.explanation: An-Nasr celebrates divine help.

questions.prompt: Surah Al-Masad condemns:
questions.explanation: Al-Masad (Lahab) targets Abu Lahab.

questions.prompt: In which Surah is the verse 'We have indeed made the Quran easy to remember' repeated four times?
questions.explanation: The refrain 'Wa laqad yassarnal-Qur'ana' occurs four times in Al-Qamar (54).

questions.prompt: The verse about the Trust (Amanah) being offered to the heavens and the earth is in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Al-Ahzab 33:72 speaks of the Trust offered to creation.

questions.prompt: The three companions whose repentance was accepted after the Battle of Tabuk are mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah 9:118 mentions the three who were left behind at Tabuk.

questions.prompt: The transformation of the Sabbath-breakers into apes is mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Al-A'raf 7:166 records the Sabbath-breakers being turned into apes.

questions.prompt: What is the 20th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Ta-Ha is the 20th chapter of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which Surah mentions the hoopoe (Hudhud) carrying news to Prophet Sulaiman (AS)?
questions.explanation: The hoopoe's report about the Queen of Sheba is in An-Naml (27).

questions.prompt: Which Surah narrates the story of the Queen of Sheba (Bilqis)?
questions.explanation: The Queen of Sheba's conversion is narrated in An-Naml (27).

questions.prompt: What is the 27th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: An-Naml (the Ant) is the 27th chapter.

questions.prompt: The she-camel of Prophet Salih (AS) is mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: The naqat Allah (she-camel) of Thamud appears in Al-A'raf among others.

questions.prompt: What is the 15th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Hijr (the Rocky Tract) is the 15th chapter.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is named after the woman who argued with the Prophet (PBUH) about her husband?
questions.explanation: Al-Mujadila (58) is named after the woman who pleaded her case.

questions.prompt: The pre-Islamic practice of 'Zihar' is condemned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Zihar is prohibited in the opening verses of Al-Mujadila.

questions.prompt: How many Surahs begin with the glorification 'Sabbaha' or 'Yusabbihu' (the Musabbihat)?
questions.explanation: Five Surahs — Al-Hadid, Al-Hashr, As-Saff, Al-Jumu'ah, At-Taghabun — open with glorification.

questions.prompt: What is the 64th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: At-Taghabun (the Mutual Loss and Gain) is the 64th chapter.

questions.prompt: Which Surah is called 'As-Saff' (the Ranks), speaking of fighting in Allah's path?
questions.explanation: As-Saff is the 61st chapter, named after the ranks of believers.

questions.prompt: The command 'Prepare against them whatever strength you can' is in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Al-Anfal 8:60 commands preparing strength against the enemy.

questions.prompt: The verse 'There is no compulsion in religion' is from which Surah?
questions.explanation: Baqarah 2:256 contains 'La ikraha fid-din'.

questions.prompt: What is the 40th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Ghafir (the Forgiver) is the 40th chapter.

questions.prompt: The supplication 'Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah' is found in which Surah?
questions.explanation: The verse 2:201 contains this famous dua.

questions.prompt: Which Surah contains the advice of Luqman to his son?
questions.explanation: Luqman's wisdom to his son is in Surah Luqman 31:13-19.

questions.prompt: Which Surah narrates the story of Qarun (Korah) and his treasures?
questions.explanation: The story of Qarun is in Surah Al-Qasas 28:76-82.

questions.prompt: The lofty city of 'Iram' (the city of the pillars) is mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Iram, the city of the 'Ad, is mentioned in Al-Fajr 89:7.

questions.prompt: What is the 34th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Saba is the 34th chapter, named after the people of Sheba.

questions.prompt: What is the 47th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Surah Muhammad is the 47th chapter.

questions.prompt: Which Surah opens with the letter 'Qaf' and the oath by the Glorious Quran?
questions.explanation: Qaf 50:1 begins 'Qaf wal-Qur'anil-majid'.

questions.prompt: Which Surah opens with the letter 'Sad' and the oath by the Quran full of reminder?
questions.explanation: Sad 38:1 begins 'Sad wal-Qur'ani dhi dhikr'.

questions.prompt: The great sacrifice offered as ransom for Prophet Ismail (AS) is mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: As-Saffat 37:107 mentions the great sacrifice in place of Ismail (AS).

questions.prompt: The dream of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) about sacrificing his son is narrated in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim's (AS) dream and obedience are in As-Saffat 37:102.

questions.prompt: The meeting of the two seas (Maraj al-Bahrayn) is mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Ar-Rahman 55:19 mentions the two seas that meet.

questions.prompt: The people of Tubba' are mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: The people of Tubba' are cited in Ad-Dukhan 44:37.

questions.prompt: What is the 44th Surah of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Ad-Dukhan (the Smoke) is the 44th chapter.

questions.prompt: The verse 'Man gets only what he strives for' is from which Surah?
questions.explanation: An-Najm 53:39 states that man attains only what he strives for.

questions.prompt: The verse promising Allah's protection of the Quran (the Reminder) is in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Al-Hijr 15:9: 'We have sent down the Reminder and We will preserve it.'
